_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9. TOOL=code/docs (public). FIXTURE=synthetic test data from tools/make_fixtures.py. DATA=real-run output, never git-tracked, lives in a private companion config.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and CI.
_audited: 2026-08-30 FIRST AUDIT. The real-run output here is a person's entire QQ chat history: pulled mobile dbs, desktop Msg3.0.db copies, decoded JSON, and .bak exports. Every landing path is declared and sealed so a real run cannot deposit history at a repo-relative path even with git add -f. The Frida monitor logs are also real-run output and are sealed.
_data_home: ~/.qq-history-recovery-config/data/   (override with $QQ_HISTORY_RECOVERY_DATA_DIR). Real-run output goes THERE, never back into this repo.
